data.name: SurfsUp
data.detailed_description:
Classic surf re-imagined in the Godot game engine. Free to play and made for everyone.

SurfsUp is a faithful recreation of community air-surfing, designed for both veterans and newcomers. Whether you're chasing world records or riding your first ramp, SurfsUp offers precise movement, a competitive feel, and an easy entry point into one of gaming's most iconic experiences.

Features

  • 125+ Maps, All Free

Every map is available to every player from day one, no unlocks or paywalls. Ride community classics like Utopia, Boreas, Summit, and Mesa alongside brand new maps built for v2.

  • Multiplayer, Your Way

Surf solo or with friends. Join public lobbies or host your own with full control over map selection, all with built-in voice and text chat.

  • Surfing Mechanics

Perfect your technique in high-speed air-surfing. Ride ramps, carve tight turns, and clear massive jumps with precision and flow. It's all about momentum, timing, and control.

  • Modes and Styles

Various ways to play with Surf, Bhop, and Climb (KZ). The new modes feature an Easy mode with reduced gravity and increased physics or play the Legacy mode with 1:1 CS:S physics, the new Freestyle mode features no resets with the ability to bhop anywhere, better keep your speed or get reset! Surf with styles like Half Sideways, Backwards, and W-Only, all with their own leaderboards!

  • Races, Replays, and Ghosts

Download any run from the leaderboard and race it as a ghost, or study it frame by frame in the replay player. Checkpoints and splits on every map show exactly where you're gaining or losing time against the world record, your friend, or against your personal best.

  • Global Rankings and Leaderboards

Compete worldwide or with your crew. Every mode, style, and input device has its own leaderboard, from mouse and keyboard players to controller surfers.

  • Make It Yours

Fully customize your HUD by dragging, scaling, and recoloring every widget. Build your own crosshair. Earn tradable player models and surf animations simply by playing.

  • Full Controller Support

Playable start to finish on a gamepad, with controller glyphs, rebindable inputs, and dedicated controller leaderboards.

  • Supporter Bundle DLC

An optional upgrade with unique cosmetics, lobby settings like no timer, lobby code only, or friends/supporters-only, custom profile flair, and support the game's development.

data.short_description: SurfsUp is a free-to-play, standalone recreation of Counter-Strike Surf where precision movement and air-surfing are the keys to setting a new personal best or even breaking a world record. Surf, bhop, and climb across 125+ maps, all for free, with unique leaderboards for every way to play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
